description: Given a document, suggest what else to look at — a learned 'what to read next' signal. Blends co-access (documents you worked on in the same sessions as this one, from the change history) with the explicit /editor links in the markdown (both directions). Returns documents ranked by relevance, each with a plain-language reason. Use it to warm-start on a topic or find the documents that tend to travel together.

documentId.description: The ID of the document to find related documents for

limit.description: Max related documents to return (default 10, max 50).

name: syncpen_related
